method: Same-host deterministic rebuild; CSS metadata reads first-frame alpha bounds only, without changing sprite pixels. Music uses standard-library math and PCM encoding, without samples.
delivery: Deferred until Music is explicitly enabled; no autoplay or initial audio request.

mix.routing: Independent Web Audio gains; music calibrated at0.12 maximum channel gain, FX tone envelope peak0.14. Percentages are equal user levels, not a claim of equal perceived loudness.
mix.ownerDevice: Owner confirmed balance and independent sliders on iPhone17/Safari. Mixer auto-pause and final text/Salvage changes followed that check.
